thread.title: Apple Stock Extends Winning Streak To Nine Days, Hits New High

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Apple Stock Extends Winning Streak To Nine Days, Hits New High
text:
Apple stock has been on a tear lately, notching record highs in three of the last five trading sessions, and rose for the ninth straight day Thursday.
X Apple ( AAPL ) shares climbed 1.4% to close at 190.04 on the stock market today , a record closing high. It ended the day just off its intraday and all-time high of 190.37, reached just minutes before the close.
The Cupertino, Calif.-based company now has a market value of about $960 billion. Some Wall Street analysts say it is on pace to become the first company with a market cap of $1 trillion.
The nine-session winning streak for Apple stock would be the longest one since last July, when it also rose for nine straight trading days.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Support At The 50-Day After last summer's nine-day rally, shares fell for the next three days, finding support at their 50-day moving average. Apple then rose 0.9% on Aug. 1 ahead of its fiscal third-quarter earnings report later that same day. The next day Apple soared 4.7% after delivering a beat-and-raise financial report the night before. The stock broke out of an 11-week flat base to record heights.
Since 2004, Apple shares have risen nine consecutive days on six occasions, including the latest. On the previous occasions, the stock usually formed a base for about a month before resuming its move higher.
Apple stock also has risen for 10 consecutive days twice since 2004, most recently in October 2010. Those are the longest winning streaks it has had in that time period.
It has rallied lately on news that investment firm Berkshire Hathaway ( BRKB ), led by Warren Buffett, has been increasing its stake in the iPhone maker.
Path To $1 Trillion Value Monness Crespi Hardt analyst Brian White on Thursday pounded the table for Apple. He rates the stock as buy with a price target of 235.
"We believe Apple is on a path to surpass the $1 trillion market capitalization milestone in the coming months," he said in a report. He pointed to Apple's strong earnings report last week and Buffett's positive comments and investment for his confidence.
If Apple traded at the average price-earnings multiple of other consumer-related stocks such as Coca-Cola ( KO ), Procter & Gamble ( PG ) and Colgate Palmolive ( CL ), Apple would already have a market cap north of $1 trillion, he said.
